name: Merry Go Around
description: A carousel is a type of amusement ride in an amusement park. There are seats decorated as wooden horses on a large rotating platform that move up and down for tourists to ride. The carousel is elegant in shape and has two floors, representing the pursuit of true love and happiness. The ponies have different shapes, and their movements are vivid and lifelike. The use of a variety of colors makes the carousel highly restored. Legend has it that the merry-go-round is a game that witnesses love. As long as two people who truly love each other sit on the merry-go-round, the merry-go-round will carry them to a happy place, and their love will last forever.
